visual_action: The video shows guests at an indoor party, including Donald Trump, sitting at round tables. The footage cuts to a large screen at the party, which is showing a large-scale musical performance by a male artist (identified in text as Bad Bunny) and female backup dancers on a stage in a packed stadium. The video cuts between shots of the party guests watching and the performance on the screen.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Visibly present at a table during a party described by on-screen text as "trumps super bowl party".

cast.name: Kid Rock
cast.evidence: Mentioned in the on-screen text: "...instead of kid rock".

on_screen_text.text: footage from inside trumps super bowl party shows them watching bad bunny instead of kid rock

spoken_summary: Indistinct background chatter is audible, with fragments like 'Yeah' and 'Hey I'.
audio_music: A driving electronic or hip-hop track plays throughout the entire video. It is overlaid and not the audio from the performance being shown on screen.
editing_pacing: The video uses quick cuts, switching between footage of the party guests and the performance they are watching on a large screen. There are also some slight zooms on the subjects.
central_claim: Donald Trump and his supporters at a Super Bowl party were watching a performance by Bad Bunny, which is presented as a hypocritical choice over an artist like Kid Rock.
intended_effect: To make the viewer mock Donald Trump and his supporters for perceived hypocrisy.
